test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the wrongly spelt word. **
solution: The correct answer is: **Alturistc** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is "**Altruistic**" • Which means selfless concern for the well-being of others. (दूसरों की भलाई के लिए निस्वार्थ चिंता) • The mistake is in the placement of the letter "**i**" and "**u**" in the word. • The correct spelling follows the pattern of "**altruism**" (noun) and "**altruistically**" (adverb). • The word can be pronounced as "**al-troo-is-tik**" or "**al-troo-ist-ik**". Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**, which is wrongly spelt. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Unsavoury **means unpleasant or distasteful. (अप्रिय या अरुचिकर) • **Ethical **means relating to moral principles or values. (नैतिक सिद्धांत या मूल्य) • **Unconventional **means not based on or conforming to what is generally done or believed. (आम तौर पर जो किया जाता है या माना जाता है उस पर आधारित या उसके अनुरूप नहीं) 1e0:T981, The correct answer is: **Corrupted**.
